- When sentiment is positive (≥ 0.20) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast peak by 2–5%.
- After a sharp price spike (forecast > 82.0), model often overshoots; cap next 3–5 days’ forecast at +10% below peak.
- If sentiment is consistently negative (≤ -0.10) over 5+ days, model underestimates; add 1–3% to forecast mean.
- Model frequently overreacts to recent sentiment swings; smooth 3-day moving average of forecast before applying.
- For 30-day horizon, model tends to overpredict late-period prices (days 25–30); reduce final 5 days by 1–4%.
- If sentiment history shows alternating +/– swings, model misinterprets momentum; align forecast with sentiment trend direction, not magnitude.
